frothy flash — flash Frothy firmware to a board

Flash writes Frothy firmware to a connected device, replacing whatever was on the chip. Use it once per board to install Frothy itself, before send or connect can talk to a running device. A packaged install uses the release firmware included by Homebrew; from a Frothy source checkout it builds that checkout first. The serial port is discovered automatically when one device is attached, or named explicitly with --port when several are. For packaged RP2040 firmware, use --bootsel after manually entering BOOTSEL when the running firmware cannot reset itself.

Examples:
  frothy flash esp32_devkit_v1 --port /dev/cu.usbserial-0001
      flash Frothy to the ESP32 board on that port
  frothy flash arduino_nano_rp2040_connect --bootsel
      flash an RP2040 board already showing its RPI-RP2 drive

Flags:
  -bootsel
    	board is already in BOOTSEL mode (packaged UF2 firmware only)
  -port string
    	serial port, for example /dev/cu.usbmodem101
